Premise reading, item 1 (H82 patrol token `checks: read`) · 2026-11-24T15:43Z · not built under claim 7136404129; item 2 is building.

- The card asks for "the latest scheduled patrol run". `.github/workflows/half-state-patrol.yml` at a73edb3c declares no `schedule:` (on demand only, ruling #208 on #19491). The workflow's run list holds 0 `workflow_dispatch` runs, so no run has ever written H82 into the anchor body.
- The latest run is 45017436563 (pull_request, 2026-11-22, PR #36434's head merged with main). Its job log shows the token's permissions as Contents read, Issues write, Metadata read, PullRequests read. There is no Checks row.
- The H82 coverage line ("Claimed card PRs (H82): …") goes to the step summary only. The sweep step sends the report to `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`, and its stderr file was empty. The job log does not carry the line, and this seat's container cannot read the step summary. So whether the check-suites read was refused is NOT MEASURED either way.
- The repository is public. GitHub documents `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{ref}/check-suites` as readable without the Checks permission when only public resources are requested, so a refusal is not expected. That is a reading of the docs, not a measurement.
- No seat can dispatch the patrol: the relay's `workflow_dispatch` allow-table for this repository lists only `shard-timings-refresh.yml` and `release.yml`.

Remainder: the one step item 1 needs is a maintainer running "Half-State Patrol" on `main` once from the Actions tab. Then H82's coverage line in anchor #9857's body says whether the read is refused, and `checks: read` is added only if it is. The card will be released with item 1 as the remainder when item 2's PR lands.

os-dev-report delta · patch round 1 · PR #37040 · head 63a45590

Correction to the report comment 7137318718. Its summary says label-write "refuses the same arm with ONE-OF (nothing written) on any other state". That is wrong. label-write refuses the amendment arm (`--add pm:dispatched` alone) only on a card that carries ANOTHER pm state label. On a card with no pm state label, the arm is not refused: it packs `comment > labels_add` with no `assign`, which dispatches the card with nobody assigned. Such a card takes the first arm, which packs `comment > labels_add > assign`.

What changed in this round, one commit `63a45590` on the same branch:

- the refusal text and both docblocks say "another pm state", and the first arm is named "a card not yet dispatched (`pm:queue` or no pm state)";
- a new control in the claim-stroke battery runs both arms through label-write's dry run on a card with no pm state, and the battery pin goes from 20 to 21.

Self-test at 63a45590: 813 cases pass across 30 batteries. Ablation: dropping "or no pm state" from the first arm's label makes the self-test report 1 of 813 failed (the new control); the file was restored to the HEAD blob `21a7ff20`. Gates at 63a45590: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 64 families, and all 64 ran with exit codes recorded; 63 exited 0. `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (no built dist closure), so it is NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI. `--ran` reconciliation: 64 accounted, 63 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED. overlap-check: VERDICT clean exit 0.
